title: An Act to Ensure Quality in Personal Care Agencies

summary.text: This bill directs the Department of Health and Human Services to establish by rule and post on a publicly accessible website annual quality performance metrics for personal care agencies. It authorizes the department to revoke the license of a personal care agency that fails to timely or adequately satisfy the metrics or file reports required by the department.
